item.description:
Changes since v0.2.27:
- Update (#164) - A merge that lands while the release job is queued ends the run with a notice instead of failing it (#163) - The README opens with a new hero, look then pinch twice then thumbs-up with the real hand, and reads in a minute from what it is to where the docs are (#162) - The dead tag-triggered release workflow is gone; releases run only through auto-release.yml and the docs say Developer ID signing is not in use (#157) - The demo loads its trackers in the background and its sees panel shows a skeleton when nothing is tracked (#159) - The home page shows the real star count from 1, and invites the first star only at zero (#158)

Changes since v0.2.26:
- Known test traps are refused before push, and the initialiser-order trap is in the gotchas (#152) - The friends' texts on the website are light, like iOS Messages, instead of dark notifications (#156) - A GitHub workflow releases every merge that changes app logic, signed with the same certificate as before, so the launchd job can go once it has succeeded (#155) - A send never presses Send after typing or a click since dictation, even when the press waited in line (#153) - The home page counts real downloads, says Open source on GitHub, and drops the demo-runs-in-browser line (#150) - A plain launchd job on the owner's Mac releases after every merge that changes app logic, once the checks pass (#154) - An agent session may open and look at the installed app to check a change on the owner's Mac (#151)

Changes since v0.2.25:
- Show a light hint when the picture stays dim, and trace every head reading so lighting can be compared (#149) - Small website and demo labels now read at 14 px or more (#148) - The first-run tour teaches headphone stem presses on an optional Headphones tab (#147) - The contributor guide's docs row links the setup page (#145) - The usage triage hands ticket drafts to its caller and no longer files GitHub issues; tickets live in Linear (#144)
